items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: I mean, with, uh, Sonny Allen and them and Walter P. Sean, that's where I went, P-Rong Band. All that was in 1928. And I worked in that band a good while.

ctx.x: Yeah. That was during the time when, uh, when Paul Bobberin, we left P-Rong Band to go with a kid, uh, Sonny Allen. Uh-huh. I mean, with, uh, Sonny Allen and them and Walter P. Sean, that's where I went, P-Rong Band. All that was in 1928. And I worked in that band a good while.
That was after you made that recording, was it? Yeah, it was way after.
